description_en: Retrieves the Object Storage Service (OSS) endpoint, directory, and Security Token Service (STS) temporary credentials required to upload image task files
description_zh: 获取上传镜像任务文件所需的 OSS 地址、目录和 STS 临时凭据
name: GetUploadInfo

parameters.help_en: The type of the file to upload. Currently, only TASK is supported, which indicates an image task file
parameters.help_zh: 上传文件类型。当前仅支持 TASK，表示镜像任务文件
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the business region where the file is uploaded. If this parameter is not specified, the default OSS region configured for the service is used
parameters.help_zh: 上传文件所在的业务地域 ID。不传时使用服务配置的默认 OSS 地域
parameters.name: biz_region_id

schema.description_en: The result of the API call

Code.description_en: The return code of the API. A value of 200 indicates success. If the call fails, the corresponding error code is returned
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。200 表示成功；失败时返回对应错误码

Data.description_en: The file upload endpoint and temporary credentials
Data.description_zh: 文件上传地址和临时凭据

AccessKeyId.description_en: The AccessKey ID of the STS temporary access credential
AccessKeyId.description_zh: STS 临时访问凭据的 AccessKey ID

AccessKeySecret.description_en: The AccessKey Secret of the STS temporary access credential. It is used together with AccessKeyId and StsToken
AccessKeySecret.description_zh: STS 临时访问凭据的 AccessKey Secret。与 AccessKeyId 和 StsToken 配套使用

BucketName.description_en: The name of the destination OSS bucket for the upload
BucketName.description_zh: 上传目标 OSS Bucket 名称

FilePath.description_en: The OSS directory prefix where files are allowed to be uploaded. The path of the uploaded object must be located under this directory
FilePath.description_zh: 允许上传文件的 OSS 目录前缀。上传对象的路径应位于该目录下
FilePath.title_en: 前端上传到oss的文件夹路径
FilePath.title_zh: 前端上传到oss的文件夹路径

OssPoint.description_en: The OSS endpoint for public network access

StsToken.description_en: The STS temporary security token. It is used together with AccessKeyId and AccessKeySecret for file uploads
StsToken.description_zh: STS 临时安全令牌。与 AccessKeyId 和 AccessKeySecret 配套用于文件上传

Message.description_en: The message returned by the API

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is used to locate and troubleshoot the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh: 接口调用是否成功。true：成功；false：失败
